title: Playtest report
description: What one playtesting agent writes to report.json in its session directory (docs/AGENT_PLAYTESTING.md). Checked by `pt report` and read by `pt aggregate`.

goal.description: The goal the agent was given, verbatim

version.description: state.json 'version', or session.json 'version'; null when the game has no probe and shows none

seed.description: The seed played (null when the game has none)

title.description: One line, specific: what is wrong where

detail.description: What was seen, what was expected

repro.description: Steps (pt commands are ideal) from a fresh start with the session's seed

screenshot.description: Path to a PNG, relative to the session directory or absolute

tick.description: Game tick when it was seen (state.json 'tick')

metrics.description: Free-form numbers the goal cares about, plus the standard ones `pt aggregate` also derives from events.jsonl

secondsToObjective.description: Objective title -> game seconds (tick / ticks per second) from the start to it completing

verdict.description: Two or three sentences a designer would want to read first
